text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I heard her voice while I was running.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: DEEERRRBYYY!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't count how many times all her silly
yelling
has cheered me up.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But today, it terrified me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Why isn't anything working? Why can't
I...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, but... I wasn't good enough—I
lost.

She's quiet again, and I'm not quite sure
what to
say.

Before I can think of something, a voice
cuts
through the air.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Winning Ticket!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wait, aren't you with...

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm with the Winning Step
Weekly!
Do you have some time for an
interview?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Sure, I don't mind! Sorry I kept turning
you down!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, not at all! So tell me, how did
you feel
about the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I loved it. All that excitement and cheering? It was awesome! I felt like I was in a dream... But you know what?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It was even better than a dream!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Even though I lost.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text: Well, there's always next time...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's okay. I tried my best. Winning
the
Derby's been my dream for so long,
and I trained
as hard as I could for it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sob... I did it all for the sake of winning this race! I really wanted to win!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sure...

Biwa Hayahide doesn't utter a word
when she
returns to the waiting room.

She's just as crestfallen as she was at the
Satsuki
Sho...

Her shoulders jump. It appears she does,
and she
appears deep in thought about
something.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, it's like you can read my
mind...
choice_data_list: ……君はあの時から何を考えてる？
……貴方はあの時から何を考えてるの？

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You always know what I'm thinking
about, down
to the exact moment.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I run, my head spins with
images of
future losses.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I've lost twice now. Once to Taishin at
the Satsuki
Sho, and again to Ticket at
the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We planned for so many scenarios and
tried to
anticipate so many variables. But
they just have
something I lack.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm scared. I don't know what that something is, but if it's not just an oversight... If it's something I'm intrinsically missing, then beating them is impossible.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But I—

Biwa Hayahide is extremely smart. Smart
enough
to figure out most things on her
own.
choice_data_list: なら2人との違いを見つめ直そう

text_block_list.text:
It's why she always tries to solve
everything alone,
even when facing an
insurmountable challenge.
But
sometimes, she needs a bit of guidance.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What?
choice_data_list: 2人のすごい所をマネてみないか？
2人のすごい所をマネてみない？

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: 『学ぶ』と『マネる』の語源は同じらしいし

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I get what you're saying, but they both
have
completely different strengths.
During races
they're—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Outside of races?
choice_data_list: じゃあレース以外では？

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Before the Satsuki Sho, I thought
Taishin's drive
was amazing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I thought same thing about her before
the Derby.
Her drive astounded me.
choice_data_list: ウイニングチケットは？

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I don't know why I thought that though...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I tried my best. Winning the Derby's
been my
dream for so long, and I trained
as hard as I could
for it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Both of them have the iron will to
improve.
choice_data_list: 何か思い当たることがあったか？
何か思い当たることがあった？

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
They have the willingness to do
whatever it takes,
even if it breaks them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Going forward, don't be afraid to push me to my limits. In fact, I want you to make me work harder.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My body can handle the pressure. I'm
stronger
than I was as a child.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I don't ever want to taste defeat again,
and to
ensure that I don't, I need to
push myself harder!

Even after we return from the Tokyo
Racecourse
to the academy, her resolve
remains steely.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I won't ever lose again!

And so, with a determination bordering
on
obsession...

Biwa Hayahide sets her sights on the
final race of
the Classic Triple Crown
tour—the Kikuka Sho.
